lane:
لثف

لثفة لُثْفَةٌ The _changing, in pronunciation,_ س _into_ ث, _or_ ر _into_ غ _or_ ل, (S, K, Msb,) _and the like:_ (Msb:) or, _one letter into another._ (Az, in Msb, K.) Also, _A word mispronounced;_ as when a word is said to be لُغَةٌ أَوْ لُثْفَةٌ _a dialectal variant or a word mispronounced._
